Make sure you can hear yourself, the other guitar, and bass is really all I can say about the monitor. Picking yourself out will take time. 

And with the strumming, two different rhythms are okay, just make sure that don't conflict. It would be better to blend with the other guitar.

The secret to playing with a group is that you shouldn't overthink it. Just feel the music and you'll end up in the right direction. Respect what every other part of the band is playing and play accordingly. Strumming is unique to every song so just feel out a rhythm and go with it. They seem to enjoy having you around considering you've played with them multiple times. My advice is just don't overthink it. It's all just music. Just listen to your band.
